description: Stone arch: a wall block with a round, pointed (equilateral gothic) or flat-topped opening cut by a 2D boolean and extruded, with impost blocks at the spring line and a keystone. Pivot at the centre of the base (the opening is centred on x = 0, depth along Z). Pieces: arch (stone), arch_trim (stone_dark). Every piece is closed.

keystone.desc: keystone at the apex and impost blocks at the spring line

opening.note: the opening outline in the XY plane, starting below the ground so the cut is open at the bottom
